648:     let planet = state
649:         .stars
650:         .get(&colony.star)
651:         .and_then(|s| s.planets.get(colony.planet_index));
652:     let empire_food_negative = state
653:         .empires
654:         .get(&empire_id)
655:         .map(|e| e.food < 0)
656:         .unwrap_or(false);
657:     let colony_yield = calculate_yield_with_context(
658:         colony,
659:         planet,
660:         YieldContext {
661:             food_shortage: empire_food_negative,
662:             stability_pressure: colony.stability < 85,
663:         },
664:     );
665: 
666:     // Determine playstyle tags and AI profile for this empire.
667:     let empire_def = state
668:         .empires
669:         .get(&empire_id)
670:         .and_then(|e| e.empire_def)
671:         .and_then(empire_definition_by_id);
672:     let playstyle: &[PlaystyleTag] = empire_def.map(|d| d.playstyle).unwrap_or(&[]);
673:     let ai_profile = empire_def.map(|d| d.ai_profile).unwrap_or_default();
674:     let doctrine = |axis| empire_def.map(|def| def.doctrine_weight(axis)).unwrap_or(0);
675:     let likes_science = ai_profile.prefers_science_ships;
676:     let likes_troops = ai_profile.prefers_troop_transports || doctrine(AiDoctrine::Imperial) >= 8;
677:     let likes_military = ai_profile.prefers_combat_ships || doctrine(AiDoctrine::Militarist) >= 8;
678:     let likes_defense =
679:         ai_profile.prefers_defensive_ships || doctrine(AiDoctrine::Isolationist) >= 8;
680:     let likes_fast_scouts = ai_profile.prefers_fast_scouts || doctrine(AiDoctrine::Explorer) >= 9;
681:     let likes_colony_arks =
682:         ai_profile.prefers_colony_arks || doctrine(AiDoctrine::Expansionist) >= 9;
683: 
684:     let is_expansionist = playstyle.contains(&PlaystyleTag::Expansionist);
685:     let is_agrarian = playstyle.contains(&PlaystyleTag::Agrarian);
686: 
687:     // Helper: check if empire has researched a tech
688:     let has_tech = |tech: TechId| -> bool {
689:         state
690:             .empires
691:             .get(&empire_id)
692:             .is_some_and(|e| e.research.completed.contains(&tech))
693:     };
694:     let colony_blockaded = state.colony_blockade_state(colony_id).is_some();
695:     let hostile_at_colony = state.fleets.values().any(|fleet| {
696:         fleet.location == colony.star
697:             && fleet.owner != empire_id
698:             && state
699:                 .relationship_status(empire_id, fleet.owner)
700:                 .is_hostile_or_war()
701:     });
702:     let defense_crisis = colony_blockaded || hostile_at_colony;
703:     let housing_crisis = colony_yield.workforce.housing_deficit >= 2
704:         || (colony_yield.workforce.housing_deficit > 0 && colony.stability < 70);
705: 
706:     if (empire_food_negative && colony_yield.food < colony_yield.food_consumed
707:         || housing_crisis && doctrine(AiDoctrine::Biologist) >= 8)
708:         && !colony.buildings.contains(&BuildingType::AquacultureBay)
709:     {
710:         let can_place_surface =
711:             planet_size.is_some_and(|size| colony.can_place_surface_building(size));
712:         if can_place_surface {
713:             return Some(BuildItem::SurfaceStructure(BuildingType::AquacultureBay));
714:         }
715:     }
716: 
717:     if defense_crisis {
718:         let has_orbital_engineering = has_tech(TechId::ORBITAL_ENGINEERING);
719:         if has_orbital_engineering && !colony.has_shipyard() {
720:             let can_place_orbital =
721:                 planet_size.is_some_and(|size| colony.can_place_orbital_installation(size));
722:             if can_place_orbital {
723:                 return Some(BuildItem::OrbitalStructure(OrbitalStructureType::Shipyard));
724:             }
725:         }
726:         if colony.has_shipyard() && has_tech(TechId::PERIMETER_DEFENSE) {
727:             if likes_military {
728:                 if has_tech(TechId::FLEET_COORDINATION) {
729:                     return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::DESTROYER));
730:                 }
731:                 if has_tech(TechId::STRIKE_DOCTRINE) {
732:                     return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::MISSILE_FRIGATE));
733:                 }
734:                 return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::ESCORT_FRIGATE));
735:             }
736:             if likes_defense {
737:                 return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::PATROL_CORVETTE));
738:             }
739:         }
740:     }
741: 
742:     // Expansionist: dispatch scouts early before building infrastructure,
743:     // but only while colonisation is not yet available.
744:     if is_expansionist && colony.has_shipyard() {
745:         let has_habitat_seeding = has_tech(TechId::HABITAT_SEEDING);
746:         let has_survey_drones = has_tech(TechId::SURVEY_DRONES);
747:         let has_troop_transports = has_tech(TechId::TROOP_TRANSPORTS);
748:         let has_rapid_transit = has_tech(TechId::RAPID_TRANSIT);
749:         let has_science_ship = state
750:             .fleets
751:             .values()
752:             .any(|f| f.owner == empire_id && f.kind.is_survey());
753:         let has_transport = state
754:             .fleets
755:             .values()
756:             .any(|f| f.owner == empire_id && f.kind == FleetKind::TroopTransport);
757:         let has_unexplored = state
758:             .stars
759:             .keys()
760:             .any(|sid| !state.ai_explored_stars.contains(sid));
761:         // Only skip FabricationYard for scouting when no colonizer tech yet
762:         if has_unexplored && !has_habitat_seeding {
763:             if likes_science && has_survey_drones && !has_science_ship {
764:                 return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::SCIENCE));
765:             }
766:             if likes_troops && has_troop_transports && !has_transport {
767:                 return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::TROOP_TRANSPORT));
768:             }
769:             // Prefer Fast Scout if researched and faction prefers it
770:             if likes_fast_scouts && has_rapid_transit {
771:                 return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::FAST_SCOUT));
772:             }
773:             return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::SCOUT));
774:         }
775:     }
776: 
777:     // Agrarian: prioritise AquacultureBay before fabrication.
778:     if is_agrarian && !colony.buildings.contains(&BuildingType::AquacultureBay) {
779:         let can_place_surface =
780:             planet_size.is_some_and(|size| colony.can_place_surface_building(size));
781:         if can_place_surface {
782:             return Some(BuildItem::SurfaceStructure(BuildingType::AquacultureBay));
783:         }
784:     }
785: 
786:     if likes_science && !colony.buildings.contains(&BuildingType::ScienceNexus) {
787:         let can_place_surface =
788:             planet_size.is_some_and(|size| colony.can_place_surface_building(size));
789:         if can_place_surface {
790:             return Some(BuildItem::SurfaceStructure(BuildingType::ScienceNexus));
791:         }
792:     }
793: 
794:     if likes_troops || likes_military || defense_crisis {
795:         let has_orbital_engineering = has_tech(TechId::ORBITAL_ENGINEERING);
796:         if has_orbital_engineering && !colony.has_shipyard() {
797:             let can_place_orbital =
798:                 planet_size.is_some_and(|size| colony.can_place_orbital_installation(size));
799:             if can_place_orbital {
800:                 return Some(BuildItem::OrbitalStructure(OrbitalStructureType::Shipyard));
801:             }
802:         }
803:     }
804: 
805:     // Priority 1: FabricationYard — only if surface slot available
806:     if !colony.buildings.contains(&BuildingType::FabricationYard) {
807:         let can_place_surface =
808:             planet_size.is_some_and(|size| colony.can_place_surface_building(size));
809:         if can_place_surface {
810:             return Some(BuildItem::SurfaceStructure(BuildingType::FabricationYard));
811:         }
812:     }
813: 
814:     // Priority 2: Shipyard — only if Orbital Engineering researched, not yet installed,
815:     // and orbital slot available
816:     let has_orbital_engineering = has_tech(TechId::ORBITAL_ENGINEERING);
817:     if has_orbital_engineering && !colony.has_shipyard() {
818:         let can_place_orbital =
819:             planet_size.is_some_and(|size| colony.can_place_orbital_installation(size));
820:         if can_place_orbital {
821:             return Some(BuildItem::OrbitalStructure(OrbitalStructureType::Shipyard));
822:         }
823:     }
824: 
825:     // Priority 3 & 4: ships only if the colony has a Shipyard
826:     if !colony.has_shipyard() {
827:         return None;
828:     }
829: 
830:     // Science/survey preferences
831:     if likes_science {
832:         let has_survey_drones = has_tech(TechId::SURVEY_DRONES);
833:         let has_advanced_survey = has_tech(TechId::ADVANCED_SURVEY);
834:         let has_science_ship = state
835:             .fleets
836:             .values()
837:             .any(|f| f.owner == empire_id && f.kind.is_survey());
838:         // Prefer Survey Cutter if unlocked, else Science Ship
839:         if has_advanced_survey && !has_science_ship {
840:             return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::SURVEY_CUTTER));
841:         }
842:         if has_survey_drones && !has_science_ship {
843:             return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::SCIENCE));
844:         }
845:     }
846: 
847:     // Fast Scout preference
848:     if likes_fast_scouts {
849:         let has_rapid_transit = has_tech(TechId::RAPID_TRANSIT);
850:         let has_fast_scout = state
851:             .fleets
852:             .values()
853:             .any(|f| f.owner == empire_id && f.kind == FleetKind::FastScout);
854:         if has_rapid_transit && !has_fast_scout {
855:             return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::FAST_SCOUT));
856:         }
857:     }
858: 
859:     // Troop transport preference
860:     if likes_troops {
861:         let has_troop_transports = has_tech(TechId::TROOP_TRANSPORTS);
862:         let has_transport = state
863:             .fleets
864:             .values()
865:             .any(|f| f.owner == empire_id && f.kind == FleetKind::TroopTransport);
866:         if has_troop_transports && !has_transport {
867:             return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::TROOP_TRANSPORT));
868:         }
869:     }
870: 
871:     // Combat ship preferences (Destroyer > Missile Frigate > Escort Frigate).
872:     // Only engage this path when the empire already has a colonizer or colonisation
873:     // is not yet available — prevents militarist AIs from never building colony ships.
874:     if likes_military {
875:         let has_colonizer = state
876:             .fleets
877:             .values()
878:             .any(|f| f.owner == empire_id && f.kind.is_colonizer());
879:         let colonization_available = has_tech(TechId::HABITAT_SEEDING);
880:         if has_colonizer || !colonization_available {
881:             let has_fleet_coordination = has_tech(TechId::FLEET_COORDINATION);
882:             let has_strike_doctrine = has_tech(TechId::STRIKE_DOCTRINE);
883:             let has_perimeter_defense = has_tech(TechId::PERIMETER_DEFENSE);
884:             // Prefer Destroyer if unlocked
885:             if has_fleet_coordination {
886:                 return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::DESTROYER));
887:             }
888:             // Otherwise Missile Frigate
889:             if has_strike_doctrine {
890:                 return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::MISSILE_FRIGATE));
891:             }
892:             // Fallback to Escort Frigate when only perimeter defense is available
893:             if has_perimeter_defense {
894:                 return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::ESCORT_FRIGATE));
895:             }
896:         }
897:     }
898: 
899:     // Defensive ship preference
900:     if likes_defense {
901:         let has_perimeter_defense = has_tech(TechId::PERIMETER_DEFENSE);
902:         let has_patrol_corvette = state
903:             .fleets
904:             .values()
905:             .any(|f| f.owner == empire_id && f.kind == FleetKind::PatrolCorvette);
906:         if has_perimeter_defense && !has_patrol_corvette {
907:             return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::PATROL_CORVETTE));
908:         }
909:     }
910: 
911:     // Colony Ark preference (if researched, prefer over standard Colony Ship)
912:     let has_colonizer = state
913:         .fleets
914:         .values()
915:         .any(|f| f.owner == empire_id && f.kind.is_colonizer());
916:     let has_habitat_seeding = has_tech(TechId::HABITAT_SEEDING);
917:     if !has_colonizer && has_habitat_seeding {
918:         if likes_colony_arks && has_tech(TechId::COLONIAL_VANGUARD) {
919:             return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::COLONY_ARK));
920:         }
921:         return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::COLONY));
922:     }
923: 
924:     // Priority 4: Scout for continued exploration
925:     if likes_fast_scouts && has_tech(TechId::RAPID_TRANSIT) {
926:         return Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::FAST_SCOUT));
927:     }
928:     Some(BuildItem::Ship(ShipDesignId::SCOUT))
929: }

935: fn ai_assign_fleet_posture(state: &mut GameState, empire_id: EmpireId, events: &mut Vec<Event>) {
936:     let def = state
937:         .empires
938:         .get(&empire_id)
939:         .and_then(|empire| empire.empire_def)
940:         .and_then(empire_definition_by_id);
941:     let doctrine = |axis| def.map(|d| d.doctrine_weight(axis)).unwrap_or(0);
942: 
943:     let militarist = doctrine(AiDoctrine::Militarist);
944:     let imperial = doctrine(AiDoctrine::Imperial);
945:     let isolationist = doctrine(AiDoctrine::Isolationist);
946:     let merchant = doctrine(AiDoctrine::Merchant);
947:     let explorer = doctrine(AiDoctrine::Explorer);
948: 
949:     let at_war_with_player = matches!(
950:         state.relationship_status(empire_id, state.player_empire),
951:         crate::state::RelationshipStatus::War
952:     );
953:     let has_hostile_colonies = state.colonies.values().any(|colony| {
954:         colony.owner == state.player_empire
955:             && state
956:                 .relationship_status(empire_id, colony.owner)
957:                 .is_hostile_or_war()
958:     });
959: 
960:     let fleet_ids: Vec<_> = state
961:         .fleets
962:         .iter()
963:         .filter_map(|(fid, fleet)| (fleet.owner == empire_id).then_some(*fid))
964:         .collect();
965: 
966:     for fleet_id in fleet_ids {
967:         let Some(fleet) = state.fleets.get(&fleet_id) else {
968:             continue;
969:         };
970:         let role = match fleet.kind {
971:             FleetKind::Scout | FleetKind::FastScout => {
972:                 if explorer >= 8 {
973:                     FleetRole::RapidResponseFleet
974:                 } else {
975:                     FleetRole::ExplorationFleet
976:                 }
977:             }
978:             FleetKind::Science | FleetKind::SurveyCutter => FleetRole::SurveyGroup,
979:             FleetKind::Colonizer | FleetKind::ColonyArk => FleetRole::ColonyEscort,
980:             FleetKind::TroopTransport => FleetRole::InvasionFleet,
981:             FleetKind::PatrolCorvette => {
982:                 if merchant >= 8 {
983:                     FleetRole::TradeProtectionFleet
984:                 } else if isolationist >= militarist.saturating_add(imperial) {
985:                     FleetRole::DefenseFleet
986:                 } else {
987:                     FleetRole::PatrolFleet
988:                 }
989:             }
990:             FleetKind::EscortFrigate | FleetKind::MissileFrigate | FleetKind::Destroyer => {
991:                 if at_war_with_player && has_hostile_colonies && imperial >= 8 {
992:                     FleetRole::BlockadeFleet
993:                 } else if militarist + imperial >= 12 {
994:                     FleetRole::StrikeFleet
995:                 } else if isolationist >= militarist {
996:                     FleetRole::DefenseFleet
997:                 } else {
998:                     FleetRole::PatrolFleet
999:                 }
1000:             }
1001:         };
1002: 
1003:         let formation = match role {
1004:             FleetRole::ExplorationFleet | FleetRole::RapidResponseFleet => {
1005:                 FleetFormation::FastAttack
1006:             }
1007:             FleetRole::SurveyGroup => FleetFormation::Balanced,
1008:             FleetRole::ColonyEscort | FleetRole::InvasionFleet => FleetFormation::EscortScreen,
1009:             FleetRole::DefenseFleet | FleetRole::TradeProtectionFleet => FleetFormation::Defensive,
1010:             FleetRole::StrikeFleet => {
1011:                 if matches!(fleet.kind, FleetKind::MissileFrigate) {
1012:                     FleetFormation::Artillery
1013:                 } else {
1014:                     FleetFormation::Aggressive
1015:                 }
1016:             }
1017:             FleetRole::BlockadeFleet => FleetFormation::Defensive,
1018:             FleetRole::PatrolFleet => FleetFormation::Balanced,
1019:         };
1020: 
1021:         if state.fleet_roles.get(&fleet_id).copied() != Some(role) {
1022:             state.fleet_roles.insert(fleet_id, role);
1023:             events.push(Event::FleetRoleChanged {
1024:                 fleet: fleet_id,
1025:                 role,
1026:             });
1027:         }
1028:         if state.fleet_formations.get(&fleet_id).copied() != Some(formation) {
1029:             state.fleet_formations.insert(fleet_id, formation);
1030:             events.push(Event::FleetFormationChanged {
1031:                 fleet: fleet_id,
1032:                 formation,
1033:             });
1034:         }
1035:         state
1036:             .fleet_names
1037:             .entry(fleet_id)
1038:             .or_insert_with(|| format!("{} {}", fleet.kind.label(), fleet_id.0));
1039:     }
1040: }

1042: fn ai_dispatch_scouts(state: &mut GameState, empire_id: EmpireId, events: &mut Vec<Event>) {
1043:     if let Some((fleet_id, destination)) = pick_scout_target(state, empire_id) {
1044:         let origin = state.fleets[&fleet_id].location;
1045:         let (turns, used_lane) =
1046:             ai_travel_turns_for_fleet(state, fleet_id, empire_id, origin, destination);

1048:             fleet_id,
1049:             ScoutMission {
1050:                 fleet: fleet_id,
1051:                 destination,
1052:                 turns_remaining: turns,
1053:                 origin,
1054:                 total_duration: turns,

1058:             events.push(Event::HyperspaceLaneUsed {
1059:                 empire: empire_id,
1060:                 fleet: fleet_id,
1061:                 from: origin,
1062:                 to: destination,
1063:             });
1064:         }
1065:         events.push(Event::AiScoutDispatched {
1066:             empire: empire_id,
1067:             fleet: fleet_id,

1069:         });
1070:     }

1073: fn ai_travel_turns_for_fleet(
1074:     state: &GameState,
1075:     fleet_id: FleetId,
1076:     empire_id: EmpireId,
1077:     origin: StarId,
1078:     destination: StarId,
1079: ) -> (u32, bool) {
1080:     let (base_turns, used_lane) = travel_turns_with_lanes(state, empire_id, origin, destination);
1081:     let mobility = state
1082:         .fleet_evaluation(fleet_id)
1083:         .map(|summary| summary.mobility)
1084:         .unwrap_or(100)
1085:         .max(1);
1086:     let supply = state
1087:         .fleets
1088:         .get(&fleet_id)
1089:         .map(|fleet| {
1090:             if fleet.kind.is_combat() || fleet.kind == FleetKind::TroopTransport {
1091:                 state.projected_fleet_supply(empire_id, destination)
1092:             } else {
1093:                 FleetSupplyState::Supplied
1094:             }
1095:         })
1096:         .unwrap_or(FleetSupplyState::Supplied);
1097:     let adjusted_turns = ((base_turns as u64 * 100 * supply.movement_penalty_pct() as u64)
1098:         .div_ceil(mobility as u64 * 100) as u32)
1099:         .max(1);
1100:     (adjusted_turns, used_lane)
1101: }

1107: /// Dispatch idle AI combat fleets toward enemy (player) colonies when at war.
1108: ///
1109: /// Only activates after turn 20 to give both sides time to build up.
1110: /// Fleets are sorted by `FleetId` for determinism; targets are sorted by
1111: /// ascending squared distance from the fleet's current position, with
1112: /// `StarId` as a tie-breaker.
1113: fn ai_dispatch_combat_fleets(state: &mut GameState, empire_id: EmpireId, events: &mut Vec<Event>) {
1114:     // Only active after turn 20 to prevent immediate combat
1115:     if state.turn < 20 {
1116:         return;
1117:     }
1118: 
1119:     // Only dispatch when formally at war with the player
1120:     let player = state.player_empire;
1121:     let at_war = matches!(
1122:         state.relationship_status(empire_id, player),
1123:         crate::state::RelationshipStatus::War
1124:     );
1125:     if !at_war {
1126:         return;
1127:     }
1128: 
1129:     // Collect idle combat fleet IDs in deterministic (BTreeMap key) order
1130:     let combat_fleet_ids: Vec<FleetId> = state
1131:         .fleets
1132:         .keys()
1133:         .copied()
1134:         .filter(|&fid| {
1135:             let f = &state.fleets[&fid];
1136:             f.owner == empire_id
1137:                 && f.kind.is_combat()
1138:                 && !state.fleet_missions.contains_key(&fid)
1139:                 && !state.scout_missions.contains_key(&fid)
1140:                 && !state.survey_missions.contains_key(&fid)
1141:         })
1142:         .collect();
1143: 
1144:     if combat_fleet_ids.is_empty() {
1145:         return;
1146:     }
1147: 
1148:     // Collect all player colony stars as attack targets (deduplicated, deterministic order)
1149:     let target_stars: Vec<StarId> = state
1150:         .colonies
1151:         .values()
1152:         .filter(|c| c.owner == player)
1153:         .map(|c| c.star)
1154:         .collect::<std::collections::BTreeSet<_>>()
1155:         .into_iter()
1156:         .collect();
1157: 
1158:     if target_stars.is_empty() {
1159:         return;
1160:     }
1161: 
1162:     for fleet_id in combat_fleet_ids {
1163:         let fleet_loc = match state.fleets.get(&fleet_id) {
1164:             Some(f) => f.location,
1165:             None => continue,
1166:         };
1167:         let role = state.fleet_role_for(fleet_id);
1168:         let def = state
1169:             .empires
1170:             .get(&empire_id)
1171:             .and_then(|empire| empire.empire_def)
1172:             .and_then(empire_definition_by_id);
